review_text: The service was wonderful and thoughtful. Staff was very polite and rooms were immaculately clean.
Oh, absolutely loved the 'ocean view' through the tiny gap between concrete buildings, and the 'peaceful' jackhammer at 7 AM!
The lobby was grand and the staff at the desk were nice, but the room itself was a disaster. AC sounded like a jet engine.
Horrible experience! 😡 Room was filthy and smelled like smoke. Staff was rude 🚫 Never coming back!
Breathtaking views, world-class dining, and impeccable concierge service. Every detail was flawless!
Average experience. The room was clean enough, but breakfast was cold and wifi was constantly dropping.
We had a delightful family stay! Kids loved the heated pool and breakfast buffet had lots of variety.
Terrible customer service. Waited 45 minutes to check in and the key card did not work twice.
Great location near the city center. Walking distance to shops and restaurants. Bed was very comfortable.
The bathroom tiles had mold and the towels smelled like damp mildew. Would not recommend to anyone.
Decent business hotel with fast wifi and quiet work desk. Nothing fancy, but gets the job done.
Pure paradise! The infinity pool looking over the bay was stunning. Will definitely return next year.
